name: Late Night Low Volume
author: Flubsound
description: For listening quietly without losing the music. Auto Level evens out tracks and sources towards -20 LUFS, gentle downward plus upward compression brings quiet details up and loud peaks down, and a fixed low-volume contour (+3 dB bass shelf with headroom protection, +1.5 dB treble shelf) offsets part of the ear's reduced sensitivity at low volume. The contour does not follow your volume setting.
